library.name: @vscode/native-watchdog
library.publishedLayout: source-only N-API addon (no explicit install script in package.json; npm auto-runs node-gyp rebuild on binding.gyp presence); no prebuilds, no test/

deviceNode.abi: napi_*/uv_thread_create left UND (host node dlopen resolves); DT_NEEDED=libc++_shared.so+libc.so; -Wl,--code-sign self-signed

electron.abi: links libshim.a (napi shim) + uv_thread_supplement (uv_thread_create via pthread_create); no napi_/uv_ UND under HIDE_NAPI_AND_UV

deviceRuntimeContext.note: 设备侧运行时供给（私有 HNP node 24.13.0 + libsyscall_fallback + HNP bin 内 device ABI 副本）为 demo 宿主供给，非库补丁、不入候选包；Electron 应用接入时由应用构建链部署 electron-oh/watchdog.node 至 HAP 应用原生库目录（electron/libs/arm64-v8a）。

electron.reference: Electron-OH 37.2.0（electron ABI 编译契约：headers electron-napi-library + libshim.a）

deviceRuntimeContext.platformStrings: Electron-OH 37/34 主进程自报 platform='openharmony'，40 自报 'ohos'——补丁 0001 与 install.cjs 双串命中

rebuild.tool: electron-oh/tools/build-addon.cjs（维护者重建路径：DevEco NDK clang++ 双 ABI 交叉编译，需要 DEVECO_SDK_HOME + node 24.13.0 headers + Electron-OH 37.2.0 electron-napi-library）
rebuild.supplement: electron-oh/tools/uv_thread_supplement.c（libshim.a 缺 uv_thread_create 的链接期补充）
rebuild.note: CI 构建通道不重编原生库：从 native-artifact.lock.json 锁定的托管归档取逐成员校验的二进制（onnxruntime-node / napi-rs-canvas 同款模式）。
